questionEn: What is called in the 7th grade chemistry course the word “When purifying salt, salt is added to water before”?
questionUz: 7-sinf kimyo kursida “Tuzni tozalashda avval suvga tuz qo'shiladi” so'zi nima deyiladi?
choicesEn: Filling the glass completely with salt
Formation of sediment at the bottom without stirring
choicesUz: Aralashtirmasdan pastki qismida cho'kindi hosil bo'lishi
explanationEn: Add salt until it stops dissolving.
